binding.purpose: Full English overview designs and substantial redesigns; not an arbitrary universal minimum for small unrelated edits.
binding.metric: Unicode code points excluding whitespace; count exact submitted prompt, one image call at a time
binding.limitation: Length does not prove useful detail, source fidelity, image quality or user acceptance. Do not pad or concatenate prior calls to pass.

scope: Exact prompt-text length only; source/visual review and user approval are separate.
